content:
The calculation logic passed most tests, but the run failed due to an incorrect ARGB color code format in the Excel template formatting.
The test_template_formatting_preserved failed with an AssertionError at cell H12. The verifier expected the yellow fill RGB to be in {'00FFF2CC', 'FFF2CC'}, but found 'FFFFF2CC'. Avoid using the 8-character ARGB format with 'FF' alpha prefix if the verifier strictly expects 6-character or specific 8-character '00' prefixes for solid fills.
